## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to grab the hand-sized orange capped bottle and place it

Task description: Use the left arm to pick up the palm-sized medicine bottle with an orange cap and place it on the blue square mat located below and to the left of the bottle in the head-camera view.

Success criteria: The bottle is horizontally near the center of the blue square mat, placed on the mat and supported rather than suspended; both grippers are open and the bottle has been released.

## Execution tips

- Grip the straighter section of the bottle body below the shoulder and above the base, allowing both pads to make full contact. Avoid gripping only the cap or the sloped shoulder, which could slip.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the bottle body at the grasp point. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides rather than merely overlapping in the image and pushing the bottle over.
- Keep the cap facing up during transport and the bottle base clear of the table, reducing the risk of tipping from dragging.
- Make small horizontal placement corrections before the bottle bottom contacts the mat. Release once supported, leaving sufficient fingertip withdrawal clearance to avoid releasing in midair or tipping the bottle while retracting.
